title: Parents and his brothers Harold and Merrill
summary: He names his father, mother and two brothers, both pianists; Merrill became a church and concert accompanist in Oakland.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did you sing in a choir?
J. M. Brown, John M. Brown.
Maggie Brown, Maggie Mae, I think it was.
Oh, Harold Brown and Merrill Brown. 2 musician.
I know Harold is in the business.

Oh, he's dead now. He was a very, very good piano accompanist and concert type player. And he was in Oakland, around the Bay area, and we had a fairly large church up in that area, and all of the concert singers that used to give concerts at the church, they would request that my brother accompany them. He was very good at that.
So both Harold and Merrill played piano, right?
